nodes.label: Upload Goose Art UI (More Goose Window)
nodes.description: Win95-style desktop window titled 'upload.cmd' containing the goose art upload form. The window has standard Win95 chrome (minimize, maximize, close buttons). The inner panel is titled 'More Goose' in a monospace/pixel font. The form contains: (1) a dashed-border dropzone area labeled '[dropzone]' for drag-and-drop file input, (2) a text input field labeled 'describe:' with placeholder text 'yield thine ballads of galactic conquest...', and (3) two side-by-side buttons: 'browse' (file picker trigger) and 'upload' (form submission). The taskbar at the bottom shows a './start' button. Overall background is a classic Win95 desktop with blue sky and green hills wallpaper.

nodes.label: Drag-and-Drop File Dropzone
nodes.description: A rectangular dashed-border dropzone component within the upload form. Labeled '[dropzone]' in monospace text at its center. Used for drag-and-drop image file upload of goose art. No preview content is visible in this state, indicating no file has been dropped yet.

nodes.label: Goose Art Description Text Input
nodes.description: A single-line text input field below the dropzone, labeled 'describe:'. Placeholder text reads 'yield thine ballads of galactic conquest...' in a humorous, lore-appropriate style. Allows the user to add a caption or description to their uploaded goose art.

nodes.label: Browse File Button
nodes.description: A Win95-style push button labeled 'browse'. Positioned to the left of the 'upload' button. Triggers the native file picker dialog to allow the user to select a local image file for upload.

nodes.label: Upload Submit Button
nodes.description: A Win95-style push button labeled 'upload'. Positioned to the right of the 'browse' button. Submits the selected image and description to the backend POST /upload endpoint.

nodes.label: Win95 Window Chrome (upload.cmd)
nodes.description: Standard Win95-style window frame with a blue title bar displaying 'upload.cmd' and three window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close) in the top-right corner. The window is rendered on a classic Win95 desktop background (blue sky, green hills).

nodes.label: Win95 Taskbar with ./start Button
nodes.description: A taskbar at the bottom of the screen displaying a './start' button, styled as a parody of the classic Win95 'Start' button using Unix shell command syntax. Part of the GooseOS Win95-aesthetic desktop environment.
